_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Motho a le mongwe vs Dealer

📖 TAOLONG YA GAME:
• O simolola ka {start_chips} tshipi
• Deko le le lengwe la dikarata tse 52 (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• O tshameka kgatlhanong le dealer (ntlo)
• Raundi e nngwe le e nngwe e latela tsamaiso ya Ultimate Texas Hold'em: o tshameka ANTE le BLIND bets, o amogela dikarata tse pedi tsa hole, o tlhopha PLAY bets tse di letlelelweng mo diphase tsa go bet, o senola dikarata tsa setshaba le o bapisa letsogo la gago le le letona la dikarata tse tlhano kgatlhanong le la dealer. Bokhoni ba gago ke go oketsa madi a gago (fa o na letsogo le letona), fa o fokotsa madi a gago (fa o na letsogo le mosesane).
• Game e fela fa o fihla 0 tshipi kgotsa fa o fihla mo tlase ga 0 tshipi mo simolong ya raundi (LOSS) kgotsa fa o fihla 1000 raundi ka tshipi (WIN)

💰 TSAMAISSO YA BET:
• ANTE: Bet e e sa tlwaelegang ya ${ante} mo raundi e nngwe le e nngwe
• BLIND: Bet e e sa tlwaelegang ya ${ante} mo raundi e nngwe le e nngwe
• PLAY: Bet e e letlelelweng mo tshamekong. Mo raundi e nngwe le e nngwe, o ka tlhopha fela e le nngwe ya tsamaiso e e latelang: (${ante4} fa o e dira mo PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} fa o e dira mo FLOP, kgotsa ${ante} fa o e dira mo RIVER. O ka folda gape mo river, o tlogela letsogo, o sa dira bet.)

🎴 TSAMAISSO YA DIKARATA:
• O amogela dikarata tse pedi tse di bonwang (dikarata tsa gago tsa hole)
• Dealer o amogela dikarata tse pedi tse di sa bonweng (tse di neng di sa bonwe ke wena)
• Dikarata tse tlhano tsa setshaba di arogelwa mo tshimologong
• Dikarata tsa setshaba di senolwa ka tsela e e tlhomileng mo diphase tsa game

🏆 TSAMAISSO YA DEALER:
• Dealer o tlhoka go nna le letsogo la PAIR (dikarata tse pedi tsa mofuta o le mongwe) go tlhoka, a dirisa dikarata tse pedi tsa letsogo la gagwe le dikarata tse tlhano tsa setshaba.
• Tsamaiso ya dealer e ama matokeo a bet, jaaka e tla tlhalosiwa ka morago.

🎮 DIPHASE TSA GAME LE DITIRO:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Ditiro: [4x] (${ante4}) kgotsa [check]
  • [4x]: Tshameka ${ante4} PLAY bet, senola dikarata tse tlhano tsa setshaba
  • [check]: O se ke wa tshameka bet, senola dikarata tse tlhano tsa setshaba

📋 FLOP:
  • Fa o tshamekile bet ya 4x: Fela [skip] e letlelelweng (senola dikarata tse pedi tsa setshaba ka boomo)
  • Fa o se ka wa tshameka bet ya 4x: [2x] (${ante2}) kgotsa [check]
  • [2x]: Tshameka ${ante2} PLAY bet, senola dikarata tse pedi tsa setshaba
  • [check]: O se ke wa tshameka bet, senola dikarata tse pedi tsa setshaba

📋 RIVER:
  • Fa o tshamekile bet ya 4x kgotsa 2x: Fela [skip] e letlelelweng (senola dikarata tsa setshaba ka boomo)
  • Fa o se ka wa tshameka bet ya PLAY: [1x] (${ante}) kgotsa [fold]
  • [1x]: Tshameka ${ante} PLAY bet, senola dikarata tsa setshaba
  • [fold]: Tlogela letsogo, lahleha ANTE le BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Dikarata tse di senolwang le di lekolwang
  • Letsogo le letona la dikarata tse tlhano (2 hole + 5 setshaba)
  • Madi a bet a a tlhomilweng go ya ka matokeo a payout

💎 MADI A BET:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer ga a tlhoke: PUSH (bet e busetswa)
  • Dealer o tlhoka & o wina: 1:1 payout (bet + madi a wina)
  • Dealer o tlhoka & o lahleha: Bet e lahlehiwa
  • Tie: PUSH (bet e busetswa)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • E sa tlwaelegang ke tsamaiso ya dealer
  • O wina: Bet e busetswa le madi a oketsegileng a go ya ka bokhoni ba gago
  • O lahleha: Bet e lahlehiwa
  • Tie: PUSH (bet e busetswa)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less than Straight: Ga go na madi a oketsegileng

📊 PLAY BET:
  • E sa tlwaelegang ke tsamaiso ya dealer
  • Bapisa letsogo la gago le la dealer
  • O wina: 1:1 payout (bet + madi a wina)
  • O lahleha: Bet e lahlehiwa
  • Tie: PUSH (bet e busetswa)

🎯 DIKGATO TSA LETSOGO LA POKER (Bokhoni go ya ka Bokhoni):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 ya mofuta o le mongwe
  2. Straight Flush: Dikarata tse tlhano tse di latelang tsa mofuta o le mongwe
  3. Four of a Kind: Dikarata tse nne tsa mofuta o le mongwe
  4. Full House: Dikarata tse tlhano tsa mofuta o le mongwe le dikarata tse pedi tsa mofuta o le mongwe
  5. Flush: Dikarata tse tlhano tsa mofuta o le mongwe
  6. Straight: Dikarata tse tlhano tse di latelang
  7. Three of a Kind: Dikarata tse tlhano tsa mofuta o le mongwe
  8. Two Pair: Dikarata tse pedi tsa mofuta o le mongwe le dikarata tse pedi tsa mofuta o le mongwe
  9. One Pair: Dikarata tse pedi tsa mofuta o le mongwe
  10. High Card: Karata e e kwa godimo e wina

⌨️  DITIRO TSA DITIRO:
• [4x] kgotsa [play bet 4x]: Tshameka ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] kgotsa [play bet 2x]: Tshameka ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] kgotsa [play bet 1x]: Tshameka ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] kgotsa [c]: Check (o se ke wa tshameka bet)
• [fold] kgotsa [f]: Fold (tlogela letsogo)
• [skip] kgotsa [s]: Skip (senola dikarata tsa setshaba ka boomo)

💡 DITIRO TSA STRATEGY:
• Dikarata tse di kwa godimo (pairs, high cards) di tlhoka 4x bets
• Bapisa tsamaiso ya dealer - dikarata tse di mosesane di ka pusha fa dealer ga a tlhoke
• BLIND bet e ka ba e le madi a oketsegileng ka dikarata tse di kwa godimo (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Bona tshipi ya gago! Fa e fihla 0 kgotsa fa e fihla mo tlase ga 0 mo simolong ya raundi, o lahleha.

⚠️  DITIRO TSA TLHOKOMELO:
• ANTE le BLIND bets di sa tlwaelegang mo raundi e nngwe le e nngwe
• PLAY bets di letlelelweng le di strategic
• Bona gore o tlhoma ditiro tse di sa tlwaelegang, le fela e le nngwe ya ditiro mo nako e le nngwe.
